question: If Rem wasn’t playing an active role, would Emilia have handled the matter of “From Zero”? If possible, I’d also like to see the version where Rem wasn’t active.
answer: Hmm, I’m not sure. If Rem wasn’t there, there’s a high chance that Arc 3 itself would have been gone very differently, and it’s unclear if “From Zero” would have happened at all. Of course I think it would have happened, but I think it would have taken a completely different form than it did. Structurally, I don’t think that Emilia could have done it, so I don’t know who would have. Maybe I realized it myself. It’s unfortunate, but at the point that Rem appeared in the story, a version without Rem became impossible. I’m sorry.
